Cacao beans.d: ICCO category for complex-flavoured beans, mostly Criollo or Trinitario, about 12% of world bean exports; Ecuador's Forastero-type Nacional is an exception.
Cacao beans.dt: share: about 12% of exports · main exporters: Ecuador, Dominican Republic, Peru

notes: Left out: Porcelana, Ocumare, Piura white bean, Madagascar Sambirano (no retrieved page naming them beyond HCP generalities). ICCO Annex C (April 2024) lists 100% fine-flavour exporters Brazil, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Grenada, Jamaica, Madagascar, Trinidad and Tobago.
